articleTitle: BCH Implementation on Zynq-7 platform for NANDFLASH
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: NANDFLASH is a mass storage device for the field of aerospace intelligent control. A BCH algorithm-based error correction IP implementation for Zynq-7 platform SOC was proposed in this paper, which can achieve the ability to correct 8-bit random errors every 512 bytes. The binary operation of galois field is integrated in the IP, an eight-bit parallel encoder is realized based on the original polynomial, and an eight-bit parallel decoder is constructed by using the generated polynomial. The decoder implements verification polynomial calculation, SIBM iteration and Chien search internally, and further expands the external interface to realize algorithm engineering deployment. Simulation tests have shown that the module can correct eight-bit errors every 512 bytes.

articleTitle: Photonic-assisted Wideband Frequency Downconversion with Self-interference Cancellation and Image Rejection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A photonic-assisted wideband frequency downconversion with simultaneous self-interference cancellation (SIC) and image rejection (IR) based on a dual-polarization Mach-Zehnder modulator (DPol-MZM) is proposed. The SIC is achieved by combining the DPol-MZM, a polarization controller, and a polarizer. The IR is performed by using a wavelength division multiplexer, two photodetectors, and an electrical 90-degree hybrid coupler. Because the received and assisted signals are injected into the system independently of each other, the system has strong robustness. The performance of the system is demonstrated through simulation experiments. The SIC depth higher than 35 dB and the image rejection ratio larger than 55 dB within 1 GHz bandwidth are achieved. Besides, the recovery 16-QAM signal has a clear constellation diagram and an EVM of 8.4%.

articleTitle: Improving AoI by Caching Placement Optimization for a Satellite-Assisted Disaster Area
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on the age of information (AoI) aware intelligent architecture of emergency service by caching placement optimization on satellite. Such an intelligent architecture can effectively improve the AoI of users when the cellular network are broken in a disaster area. Unlike the traditional method, our architecture can learn through interaction with the environment, continuously optimizing the cache policy to improve cache hit rate and system performance. Specifically, we first model the emergency service process of the satellite as a Markov process. Then, we apply the advantage actor-critic (A2C) algorithm to obtain the optimal satellite cache strategy. By extensive simulation results, we can verify that the proposed intelligent architecture outperforms the existing traditional methods.

articleTitle: The Effect of Matching Block Resolution on IP Softcore Hardware Trojans Map Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In recent years, IC design technology has developed rapidly, and the use of third-party intellectual property (3PIP) soft cores has become mainstream. In which maliciously implanted hardware Trojans maliciously tamper with the original circuits have become a core security threat to ICs. Based on the grey scale map analysis IP soft core hardware Trojan detection method is to use the RTL level program written in the IP soft core mapped into a grey scale map and then start matching detection. This paper briefly describes the basic concept and classification of hardware Trojans, the results of current research, gives the results of greyscale mapping analysis and detection, and experimental verification of B19-T100 hardware Trojans, which account for only 0.11% of the Trojan-free circuits. Through the analysis of the results found that when the matching block resolution of 500, the hardware Trojan recognition rate of 100%, continue to increase the resolution of the detection effect has no effect; when the matching block resolution is reduced to 300, the hardware Trojan recognition rate of only 5.38%, continue to reduce will make the recognition rate even lower. Under the premise of guaranteeing the detection effect, reducing the resolution of matching block can increase the number of detection samples, improve the detection rate, enhance the detection effect, and achieve the detection of hardware Trojan.

articleTitle: Open and Linked Data Model for Carbon Footprint Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Carbon footprint quantification is key to well-informed decision making over carbon reduction potential, both for individuals and for companies. Many carbon footprint case studies for products and services have been circulated recently. Due to the complex relationships within each scenario, however, the underlying assumptions often are difficult to understand. Also, re-using and adapting a scenario to local or individual circumstances is not a straightforward task. To overcome these challenges, we propose an open and linked data model for carbon footprint scenarios which improves data quality and transparency by design. We demonstrate the implementation of our idea with a web-based data interpreter prototype.

articleTitle: Micro-Bending Influence on Mode-Dependent Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Micro-bending with random curvature is usually used to model the mode coupling in few mode fiber (FMF). However, previous models overlooked the accompanied mode dependent loss (MDL) and neglected the order constraints of coupling loss between different modes. In this work, we calculate out the accompanied loss of each mode by using the finite element method. The results show that MDL always increases with bending curvature due to the high-order modes have larger loss than low-order modes. This observation has been confirmed by experiments. Finally, we compare the multi-segment FMFs model with and without considering the accompanied MDL, the results show that micro-bending would degrade the system performance especially when considering the accompanied MDL.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Audio Recognition for Equipment Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In the country's heavy industry, as one of the key components of rotating machinery and equipment, bearings play an extremely important role. In the actual industrial production process, in order not to affect the normal operation of the entire mechanical equipment, we will try our best to avoid its failure, which is of great significance to the protection of life and property safety. To solve this problem, we propose a method that comprehensively considers the Mel frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC) and wavelet packet energy, extracts the features generated in the chemical pump and other equipment of the bearing fault diagnosis plant, extracts its features, and uses MFCC template matching and energy distribution analysis to determine whether the equipment is operating normally. The analysis results show that this method can obtain better feature extraction effect and recognition rate.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Communication Architecture And Network Protocol for Cislunar Constellation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This decade has seen increasing interest in lunar explorations and the vision of cislunar economy. Serving for the follow-up lunar and cislunar explorations and utilizations, ideas of cislunar constellation have been proposed to provide foundational supports for cislunar activities, including communication, navigation and other information services. Considering the large-scale ranges and orbital features, we proposed a hierarchical communication architecture and network protocol for cislunar constellation. Nodes in multiple types of orbits, such as ellipse lunar frozen orbit (ELFO), distant retrograde orbit (DRO), Earth-Moon Lagrange (EML) Halo orbit and Near Rectilinear Halo Orbit (NRHO), are analyzed to set up a comprehensive multi-rank relay access, and eventually form a hierarchical network. Compliant with International Telecommunication Union (ITU) radio regulation and CCSDS standards, layered network protocol is proposed to define the frequency allocations of different transmission links which construct the whole network, and also define the protocol of information flow within this heterogeneous integrated network. Then, using lunar south-polar exploring missions as a user scenario of cislunar constellation services, a system design case is demonstrated in order to show an example of developing phased of the proposed constellation and communication architecture. This paper provides a top-level option for guiding the future cislunar constellation design.

articleTitle: Designing Dielectric-Metalens with Selection of Structural Units Encircling an Exceptional Point
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In prevailing optical metalens design, phase-shifting elements are primarily realized through physical mechanisms, such as resonant scattering and orientation-dependent phase retardations. This study introduces a novel approach to control the phase-designing elements. We establish a topologically protected complete <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$21\pi$</tex>-phase variation encircling an exceptional point in the Si-dielectric metalens, which can be conceptualized as a non-Hermitian system. More specifically, the Si-dielectric metalens comprises S-shaped cuboidal structural units, and the required phases are obtained by modifying the geometrical parameters of these units. The metalens exhibits superior focusing performance at a center wavelength of 570 nm, with a bandwidth of 70 nm, along with a satisfactory field of view and efficiency. Our findings pave the way for novel mechanisms and the design of functional photonic devices for wave manipulation, futher integrating exceptional point physics with flatland optics.

articleTitle: Delay-Aware Device Grouping in IEEE 802.11ah-Based Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the flourishment of Internet-of-Things (IoT), wireless systems are expected to serve a massive number of IoT devices (IoTDs) with diverse service requirements. Wi-Fi Alliance introduced IEEE 802.11ah for IoT applications. The restricted access window (RAW) mechanism in IEEE 802.11ah can alleviate congestion due to a huge number of simultaneous access requests. IEEE 802.11ah adopts the uniform device grouping method, which uniformly assigns IoTDs to slots in one RAW. However, in one RAW group with both delay-tolerant devices (DTDs) and delay-sensitive devices (DSDs), the performance of delay-sensitive devices (DSDs) will be severely affected by DTDs. In this paper, a delay-aware device grouping method for RAW (DADG-RAW), which allocated dedicated slots for DSDs, was suggested to improve the performance of DSDs. Simulation results demonstrated that the proposed approach could improve the performance of DSDs in terms of throughput, delay, and satisfaction ratio when compared to the traditional RAW.

articleTitle: Toward Real-time Truncated Probabilistic Shaping: HiDM and MTO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This study compared the Many-to-One (MTO) Mapping algorithms and Hierarchical Distribution Matching (HiDM) algorithms under TPS-64QAM modulation for the first time. MTO exhibits better post bit error rate performance at low SNR compared to HiDM, but performs worse at high SNR. The comparison on the FPGA platform shows that MTO has approximately 1/13 of the power of HiDM.

articleTitle: A Phase Sensitive OFDR-based Distributed Optical Fiber Strain Sensing System with High Precision and Spatial Resolution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In phase sensitive OFDR systems, tuning scanning nonlinearity and phase demodulation algorithm are the key factors that affect the system performance. By adopting improved nonlinear phase compensation algorithm based on polynomial regression algorithm (PRA) and phase demodulation algorithm based on arctangent function and differential-self-multiplying (ARC-DSM), we demonstrate a scheme of phase sensitive OFDR-based distributed optical fiber strain sensing system with high precision and spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Dynamic Link State Routing Scheme for Quantum Key Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Quantum key distribution, as a physical principle-based encryption scheme, can circumvent the encryption risks associated with increased arithmetic power. With the gradual completion of hardware architecture, key relaying and distribution between nodes over long distances can be achieved, thus it becomes possible to implement quantum key encryption in large scale complex networks. In this paper, an adaptive link overhead routing algorithm for enhanced networks based on quantum key distribution is proposed, combined with a shortest path-based routing scheme that jointly determines link overheads according to link capacity and key generation rate, and simulation under 7-node and 10-node network topologies are completed.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Feature Extraction of Rotating Bearing Signal in Chemical Pump Equipment Based on SSA-VMD-HT Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the early fault characteristics of rotating bearings of chemical pump equipment are weak and difficult to find and realize non-contact signal extraction, an audio signal fault feature extraction method that improved Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) based on Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) combined with Hilbert Transform (HT) is proposed. The SSA-VMD-HT method first optimizes VMD parameters by using Sparrow Search Algorithm, and then decomposing VMD signals to obtain a set of intrinsic mode functions (IMF), and then use correlation coefficient to select modal components containing more fault information, and finally use Hilbert Transform for instantaneous energy analysis to achieve fault feature extraction. The experimental simulation shows that SSA-VMD-HT method can reflect the characteristic information of fault signals more accurately than the traditional VMD method, and effectively improve the differentiation of fault types.

articleTitle: A MIMO Detector Utilizing DNN for Faster-Than-Nyquist Optical Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Traditional multiple input multiple output (MIMO) detection algorithms encounter challenges with computational complexity and performance limitations when dealing with high-dimensional inputs and complex channel conditions. To improve the precision of signal recovery in atmospheric turbulence channels for faster-than-Nyquist (FTN) optical wireless communication (OWC) systems, a deep learning (DL) based MIMO detector is proposed. By utilizing a deep neural network (DNN), nonlinear mappings in MIMO systems can be learned, leading to improved detection performance and reduced computational overhead. Simulation results demonstrate that our proposed DNN detector can achieve comparable performance to the maximum likelihood (ML) method and the complexity is reduced by 37% compared with the ML.

articleTitle: 2µm All-Fiber Q-Switched Laser Based on EOM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-fiber pulsed laser operating in the 2 µm wavelength range, based on electro-optic Q-switching technology. Mach-Zehnder interferometric electro-optic modulators is utilized for Q-switching, achieving all fiber integration. The pulse output characteristics of the electro-optic modulators Q-switching is investigated, resulting in a laser centered around at 1937 nm with 3 dB bandwidth of 0.05 nm. Continuous tuning of the repetition frequency in the range of 20–90 kHz yielded stable pulse laser operation, demonstrating excellent stability.

articleTitle: A Low-Loss Fused Biconical Taper Type Few-Mode Multiplexer/Demultiplexer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A low-loss all-fiber mode converter is fabricated, and it forms a mode multiplexer/demultiplexer by cascading 4-mode (LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>, LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>, LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>, LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</inf>) multiplexer. Then, it is prepared by the fused tapering method. The cascade experiment evaluates the insertion loss and crosstalk. Insertion loss is less than −5.5dB, and crosstalk is less than −15 dB. Moreover, the wavelength flatness of insertion loss in the C-band is less than 1.137 dB. Fifty-time repeated experiments have proven the stability of the process. As a result, it verifies the possibility of mode division multiplexing transmission in commercial applications.

articleTitle: Dual-parameter sensor based on polarization-maintaining fiber Mach-Zender interferometer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A FMF-PMF-FMF sensor for measurement of the temperature and curvature based on the Mach-Zehnder interferometer is proposed and demonstrated experimentally. The length of this fiber sensor is only 17mm. Through demodulating the dip wavelength and intensity of transmitted spectrum, the sensitivities to the temperature and curvature are 77 pm/°C and - 5.02dB/ m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, respectively. This fiber sensor is simple and easy to fabricate, has high sensitivity, and can be applied to other fields, such as biological and chemical sensings.

articleTitle: A Tunable Optoelectronic Oscillator Based on Microwave Phase Shifters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A novel realization of a tunable optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) based on a dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator (DPMZM) and two tunable microwave phase shifters (PS) is experimentally demonstrated. By adjusting the time delay of the microwave signal which is sent to two radio frequency (RF) ports of DPMZM, the center frequency of the multiband microwave photonics filter (MMPF) can be tuned. When the OEO feedback loop is closed, single-frequency microwave signals with a tuning range from 3.6 to 15.6 GHz are generated. The side mode suppression ratio is 67 dB, and the phase noise is measured to be - 104 dBc/Hz when the oscillation frequency is 9.2 GHz. The frequency drift is less than 24 kHz in 1600 s without phase-locked or compensation devices.

articleTitle: High Precision Reconnaissance of UAV Formation Based on Multi-frequency Virtual Aperture United Electromagnetic Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: with rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) technology and their widely applications in both civil and military areas, the UAVs bring increasingly huge safety hazards. The various UAV formations designed for complex tasks are bringing greater challenges to anti-drone protection research. This paper presents a high precision UAV location method based on multi-frequency united electromagnetic imaging, in which the spatial frequency sampled by the interferometric baseline is applied as the unified representation for different interception frequencies. An electromagnetic image for target detection is generated by the united multi-frequency synthetic apertures. Compared to traditional single array imaging processing, multi-frequency virtual aperture united electromagnetic imaging has the advantages of better array factor and higher array processing gain, which eminently suits UAV formation high precision reconnaissance.

articleTitle: A frequency-doubling optoelectronic oscillator based on stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We proposed a structure for a double frequency optoelectronic oscillator based on the stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) effect. In this scheme, SBS is used to disrupt the equilibrium of the ± 1st order sidebands generated by the phase-amplitude modulation of the phase modulator. Then tapping the frequency by the photodetector (PD) to obtain a 10 GHz fundamental signal with a side-mode rejection ratio of 43dB and a phase noise of -113.70dBc/Hz@10kHz. Simultaneously, the dual parallel Mach-Zehnder Modulator (DP-MZM) is driven to work at the minimum transmission point (MITP) to realize the double side band with suppressed carrier (DSB-CS) modulation. And finally produce a double frequency 20GHz signal with a side-mode rejection ratio of 37dB and a phase noise of - 108.36dBc/Hz@10kHz. The resulting double frequency signal has a frequency drift of less than 3kHz and a power drift of less than 1dBm, which indicates that it has good performance.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Coding Modulation Technique of Atmospheric Optical Communication Based on LDPC Code
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the transmission mode switching threshold is not accurate due to turbulence in atmospheric optical communication, a threshold switching selection method based on LDPC coding combined with BPSK modulation is proposed. The performance of lognormal channel model under weak turbulence conditions was analyzed, Monte Carlo method was used to simulate weak turbulence channel fading, and the formula for the relationship between turbulence intensity and signal-to-noise ratio threshold was given. The logarithmic variance of light intensity scintillation index was used as the turbulence intensity index, and the simulated weak turbulence intensity was 0,0.05, 0.15. The relationship between bit error rate and SNR of three transmission modes under 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup>1e-5 is obtained, and the threshold switching interval of three transmission modes is obtained when the expected bit error rate of the system is. The simulation results show that the proposed method can dynamically switch transmission modes according to channel changes, and accurately realize the requirement of bit error rate of the system.

articleTitle: A Reliable and Efficient UWB-Based Indoor Localization Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Ultra Wideband (UWB) technique is a popular choice for indoor localization due to its immunity to interference and high range-estimation accuracy. However, the range-range based localization requires multiple anchors, e.g., 2D localization requires 3 anchors, which is not efficient and limits its application in complicated indoor or underground environment. Moreover, if the line-of-sight (LoS) path is blocked, the estimated range will suffer large errors and the localization is not reliable. To overcome these drawbacks, an efficient UWB-based reliable indoor localization scheme is proposed in this paper. We first develop a basic UWB-based 3D localization scheme with only a single anchor, where both range estimation and angle estimation are utilized. More specifically, a sparse array is designed to improve the angle estimation accuracy. After that, a reliable joint localization scheme is developed with two mechanisms. Firstly, a non-line-of-sight (NLoS) determination mechanism is designed to avoid using the estimated data obtained from NLoS paths. By examining whether the first path in channel impulse response (CIR) has the largest energy, the system can accurately discard the data with large errors. Secondly, an improved joint localization method with multiple anchors is proposed to further increase the localization accuracy. Since a minor error in angle of arrival (AoA) can result in a large deviation in range for a distant target, the position data obtained from these anchors are given smaller weights in acquisition of the final location. Experiments are conducted to validate our design and results show that the NLoS determination mechanism is effective, and the proposed joint localization method can improve the localization accuracy by 18%.

articleTitle: Staircase Codes For MIMO-FSO System Over Gamma-Gamma Turbulence Channel With Spatially Correlated Fading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The implementation of multiple input multiple output (MIMO) technique in free-space optical (FSO) systems can improve reliability and data rate without requiring additional system bandwidth or transmit power. However, the presence of atmospheric turbulence and spatially correlated fading can significantly deteriorate the system performance. Staircase codes (SCCs) exhibit robust error correction capability and enable substantial coding gains in fading channels. Therefore, the combination of SCCs and MIMO techniques is employed in FSO communications to further resist turbulence fading and spatially correlated fading effects. Simulation results demonstrate that the use of SCCs effectively alleviate the fading effect, resulting in a net coding gain (NCG) exceeding 17 dB.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Semi-Asynchronous Federated Learning Based on Over-the-Air Computation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the explosive growth in demand from application scenarios, such as industrial IoT, the clients process data locally are increasingly imminent. However, due to the uncertainty of the local network, some dropped clients may result in a slower convergence speed and a worse test accuracy. To solve the above problems, we propose a new framework to alleviate the strict synchronization requirements of FedAvg algorithm with Over-the-Air Computation(OTC), as well as to reduce the consumption of communication resources. In our framework, we introduce free clients and corresponding deadline to reduce the latency caused by dropped clients. The free clients and deadline time are realistic set, and we also analyze their effectiveness. We found that under the premise of achieving the same test accuracy, the time consumption with free clients is 14% less than that without free clients.

articleTitle: Detection of Void Defect in High-Speed Ballastless Track Based on Sound Energy Attenuation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The health of the high-speed railway track structure is essential for the safe operation of high-speed trains. Among the typical defects between structural layers, voiding in mortar layers is a prominent issue that requires quick and accurate detection. Drawing on the principles of reverberation in room acoustics, this paper proposes a sound-based detection method to address this problem. The rate of change in sound energy is used as a distinguishing feature for sound analysis. The attenuation time of echo signals is employed to estimate the presence of voids in the mortar layer. To validate our approach, contact experiments were conducted using marble-granite slabs. Steel balls were used to impact the slabs, and the resulting echo signals were captured by microphones. The experimental results demonstrate a clear correlation between the attenuation time of echo signals and changes in the contact area between the marble and granite slabs. This implies that voids within the intermediate layer can be identified solely by analyzing the sound produced when impacting the marble slab.

articleTitle: Research on Passive Optical Dental Implant Dynamic Navigation System Based on Binocular
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In the digital era, the continuous advancement of computer technology has profoundly impacted the field of clinical medicine. Surgical navigation, as a key application of computer-assisted navigation, has played a pivotal role in surgical procedures. The integration of medical imaging and positioning technologies has driven surgery towards minimally invasive approaches and higher precision, offering safer and more effective treatment options for patients. Particularly in the field of dental implantology, precise surgical positioning and real-time monitoring are paramount. This paper introduces a dynamic navigation system for dental implants that utilizes passive optical positioning. The system relies on tracking the reflection of markers through dual-camera optical sources, establishing spatial relationships among the patient's oral cavity, the dual cameras, and the dental implant instrument. This technology not only enables precise registration of image data with the position of the drilling needle but also calculates and determines the spatial coordinates of the dental implant's tip in real time. These critical pieces of information are intuitively presented on a visual screen, integrating with the preoperative virtual model of the implant site. This allows surgeons to continuously monitor the angle and depth of implant placement in real-time, facilitating necessary adjustments during the surgical procedure. Consequently, this approach enhances the precision and safety of dental implant surgeries.

articleTitle: All polarization-maintaining mode-locked figure-nine fiber laser with pulse switchable
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a self-starting all polarization-maintaining mode-locked figure-nine fiber laser, three different types of output pulses can be obtained by adjusting the pump power, including loosely bound pulse, dipulse, and monopulse. When the pump power reaches 242 mW, the laser can realize self-starting mode-locked with multi-pulse state, and the loss-locked threshold is 55mW. The obtained solition pulse repetition rate is 7.84MHz, the central wavelength is 1560nm, and the 3dB bandwidth is 3.1nm, SNR can reach up to 67.3dB. In the monopulse state, the laser output average power is 0.528 mW and the single pulse energy is 0.067 nJ. In addition, The power stability of the laser was measured lasting 120min, which proved that the laser has well working stability.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Sensing System Based on 1550 nm Ring Fiber Laser
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Optical fiber magnetic field sensor plays an important role in fiber sensing field. This paper proposed a magnetic field sensing system based on ring cavity fiber laser with the demodulation of beat frequency. The active fiber of the laser was rolled on a Terfenol-D based transducer and act as the magnetic field sensing component. As a kind magnetostrictive material, the length expansion of Terfenol-D rod occurs when a certain magnetic field was applied on it, ultimately lead to the length change of fiber cavity. Thus, a remarkable beat frequency shift can be observed, and the corresponding magnetic field can be measured as well. The proposed sensing system is found to be characterized with simplicity, easy setup, and high resolution. The experiment result shows a sensitivity of 0.33KHz/mT reached.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Student Evaluation of Teaching Based on Bi-LSTM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: As the basis of evaluating the teaching quality, the data of students' teaching evaluation play an important role in teaching management and improving teaching quality in universities. Nevertheless, it is challenging to conduct statistical analysis of a substantial number of instructional evaluation texts using manual or conventional technologies. How to deal with and make use of students' teaching evaluation texts efficiently has become an urgent problem to be solved. Based on Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM), this paper takes students' teaching evaluation texts dataset as the research object to analyze the emotional tendency of students. From the evaluation results, compared with Simple Recursive Neural Network (Simple RNN) and single Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), the sentiment detection model based on Bi-LSTM has higher accuracy in students' teaching evaluation texts sentiment analysis, the verification accuracy can reach 90.77%, and the testing accuracy can reach 84.33%.

articleTitle: Video Super-Resolution Reconstruction Based on Group Spatio-Temporal Projection Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the booming development of short video era, super-resolution reconstruction has gradually developed into a pivotal research direction in computer vision. Although existing video super-resolution has achieved good results, many methods do not consider the correlation of spatio-temporal information. To address this problems, we constructs a one-stage spatio-temporal video super-resolution reconstruction model, GSPN. The model completes the extraction of inter-frame information through feature extraction and feature interpolation, the feature grouping module realizes the mutual complementation of different groups of information, the intra-group alignment module better handles the blurring and artifacts generated when the video motion is large, the intra-group mapping as well as the fusion module realizes the fusion of spatio-temporal information, which in turn improves the quality of the video.

articleTitle: Real-Time Audio Transmission System Using NLOS UV Communication Based on Wall Reflections
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A real-time audio transmission system based on ultraviolet non-line-of-sight communication is experimentally demonstrated. The performance of the system is investigated under different pointing directions of the transmitter. A 6.144- Mbps audio signal is transmitted with no error when the azimuth angle of the transmitter changes in the range of 50°.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison Between Bit Weight Intervention and CCDM Based Probabilistic Shaping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we verify the shortcomings of constant component distribution matching (CCDM) over well weight intervention (BWI), the advantages of BWI in other aspects, and some engineering scenarios.

articleTitle: A Grade Prediction Model Using Knowledge Graph and Time Series
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In order to improve student achievement and reduce the failure rate, student achievement prediction is particularly important. At present, the methods of collaborative filtering and linear regression are mainly used to predict student achievements. However, only using academic performance to predict can not reflect the characteristics of students. Because according to the analysis of course content, there may be similarities between courses and time series characteristics.Above the problems, this paper proposes a course prediction method based on knowledge graph to learn and extract user features and relationships, and forecast using a time series model. The experimental results show that the course grade prediction method based on knowledge graph can reduce the error and enhance the interpretability of the model.

articleTitle: Hardware-Efficient Neural Network-Based Receiver for Intensity-Modulated Direct-Detection Short-Reach Optical Links
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Intensity-modulated direct-detection (IMDD) systems dominate short-reach optical communication applications such as data center interconnects. However, the nonlinear IMDD channel as well as the non-ideal response of low-cost devices introduce severe performance penalty. In recent years, various neural network (NN)-based receivers become popular solutions for IMDD links due to their excellent system performance. Nevertheless, the complexity of NN-based equalizers is an important concern targeting at real-time hardware implementation. In this paper, we provide several complexity reduction approaches towards hardware-efficient NN-based receivers, including multi-symbol equalization, network pruning and quantization.

articleTitle: Enhanced Precision in Frequency and Phase Spectrum in Optical Frequency Domain Reflectometry Using Zoom-FFT Based Spectrum Refinement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We present optical frequency domain reflectometry relying on frequency spectrum refinement based on zoom fast Fourier transform. Without posing sacrifices in the processing consumption, this frequency domain processing allows improving the precision in the frequency and in particular, phase spectrum. Both numerical and experimental demonstration have been carried out, testifying the estimation of frequency, amplitude, and phase with an improved error performance.

articleTitle: Spatial Attention Enhanced Wafer Defect Classification Algorithm for Tiny Defects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Wafer inspection is a crucial step in the semiconductor manufacturing process. Accurate inspection of wafer defects is of great significance in ensuring chip quality, improving production efficiency, and reducing cost losses. Surface defects, such as pits and scratches, have a significant impact on chip yield during the intricate wafer manufacturing process. For further higher inspection capability, conventional semiconductor inspection methods are limited by optical imaging resolution and signal capture capabilities, resulting in low efficiency. Therefore, there is a need for a more efficient and high-performance automatic wafer defect inspection method in the semiconductor manufacturing industry. To address this challenge, a deep learning network for wafer defect classification that uses spatial attention block and residual structure is proposed. Moreover, as defects in wafer images only occupy a very small portion of the entire image scale, therefore, easily overlooked. Therefore, hot-spot mapping and denoising were carried out to effectively enhance the defect features in the wafer images. The proposed algorithm is evaluated by classifying defects in real wafer data collected by a home-developed optical system. The algorithm has demonstrated a comprehensive classification performance, even with a limited number of defect samples, surpassing other models.

articleTitle: A Positioning Method of Weak Optical Fault in GPON Network Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of broadband business and the continuous growth of GPON networks, the problem of weak optical fault is becoming more and more serious, which is an important factor affecting service quality. Combined with actual maintenance data, the causes of weak optical fault in GPON network is analyzed, and a positioning method of weak optical fault based on support vector machine (SVM) algorithm is proposed to quickly locate fault section. The experimental results show it can greatly improve the efficiency of weak optical fault processing in GPON network.

articleTitle: Researches Advanced in Survivable Virtual Network Embedding Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Network virtualization is aimed to introduce a layer of abstraction between applications and physical hardware, which could create, provision, and manage networks in term of flexibility and reliability. In this paper, we focused on the studies in survivable virtual network embedding methods for various modern networks such as 5G slicing networks, resilient optical network, and data center networks. We first introduced the basic definition of virtual network embedding, and then we explained the survivable virtual network embedding algorithms of protection or recovery mechanisms, especially in multi-link failures. We discussed the strengths and limitations of the survivable virtual network embedding algorithms and also concluded the potential future research directions.

articleTitle: Morphing Control of Active Optics Reflectors via Compound Excitation Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This paper discusses the excitation methods on the active film for the morphing control of the thin shell reflectors for space Active Optics; the polymer materials are considered for this application. Two main implementations of generating strain actuation are examined: (1) charging the electrodes with active film in between and (2) injecting the electron flux on the surface of the active film. A compound actuation strategy is also reported for hierarchical control of shape refinement of the large primary mirror for a space telescope.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Context Aggregation Network for Inharmonious Region Localization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the ubiquity of image editing techniques, synthetic images produced by users often suffer from a lack of visual coherence due to color and illumination discrepancies between foreground objects and their surrounding backgrounds. Inharmonious region localization (IRL) naturally arises as a direction for exploration following image harmonization. As a fundamental task, inharmonious region localization aims at identifying the inharmonious regions in an image. In this paper, we propose a multi-scale context aggregation network for inharmonious region localization. Specifically, we employ a U-like structure to extract multi-scale features and adopt polarized self-attention mechanism for cross-scale context aggregation. In addition, we design a focal loss to balance the positive and negative samples. We compare our proposed method with existing IRL methods on benchmark datasets. Experimental results show that our method achieves significantly better performance, which demonstrates the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Chirp Characteristics of Directly Modulated Lasers During Multilevel Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The chirp characteristics of directly modulated lasers (DMLs) are the major constraint on the performance of directly modulated optical communication systems. However, studies on the chirp characteristics of DMLs are typically focused on binary-level modulation. An analysis of the chirp characteristics is presented for DMLs during multilevel pulse amplitude modulation (PAM) to explore the similarities and differences in chirp behavior between DML applied to multilevel modulation and two-level modulation. Simulation results of transient chirp and adiabatic chirp of four-level, eight-level, and sixteen-level PAM signals agree with the analytical findings. Increasing the number of levels in the PAM signal reduces the probability of larger amplitude chirps and improves interference immunity. Moreover, the adiabatic chirp is more influential at lower bit rates, while transient chirp dominates at higher bit rates. Finally, this paper analyzes the impact of chirp on fiber transmission dispersion and the compensation methods. The results show that the chirp exacerbates the dispersion, especially the adiabatic chirp, which leads to severe eye diagram tilt. Analysis of chirp characteristics facilitates further compensation and utilization to improve the performance of DMLs.

articleTitle: Communication and Computing Integrated Service Deployment Algorithms for All-Optical Clos Datacenter Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We address the service deployment challenge in all-optical datacenter networks (DCNs) featuring a Clos topology, where the network is built using N×N wavelength selective switches (WSSs). We develop efficient routing, wavelength, computing, and time slot allocation (RWCTA) algorithms by extending the traditional waveplane-based algorithm to deploy the unicast and ring allreduce services, including waveplane-based (WP) and computing-wavelength plane-based (CWP) algorithms, respectively. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed CWP algorithm significantly reduces the overall task completion time (TCT) for both the unicast and ring allreduce services.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Radio Spectrum Map Prediction Based on Fully Connected Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the existing radio spectrum maps only consider the two-dimensional map environment hardly meet the engineering requirements, and the simulation time of ray tracing is too long, this paper proposes a three-dimensional (3D) radio spectrum map construction method. First, the ray tracing method is used to obtain the data set, use the data set to train the fully connected neural network, obtain the preliminary model, and set the correction function, so that the model can be modified by a few measured points. Receiving point coordinates and Reference Signal Receiving Power (RSRP) can be obtained only by inputting coordinate values and house map data, and 3D radio spectrum map can be obtained by converting RSRP into thermal values and drawing it into 3D thermal map. The paper reports a remarkable achievement in RSRP prediction accuracy, achieving up to 95% accuracy within 5dB. Furthermore, the proposed method is noted to be significantly faster—up to 60 times—than traditional ray tracing simulations.

articleTitle: To Work-Conserving Packet Scheduling by Load Balance for VOQ Switches
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The IQ switch architecture has significant performance degradation compared to the OQ switch architecture because it cannot run in a work-conserving fashion. In this paper, we introduce a new two-stage switch architecture without speedup, then propose the MSKM algorithm and the load balancing algorithms, which employ work-conserving conditions without the out-of-sequence problem. The simulation results indicate that the switch is further approaching work-conserving, and improves its throughput and average delay performance.

articleTitle: Performance of OSTBC in MIMO Backscatter Communications over Nakagami-m fading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Backscatter communications is regarded as a promising technology in Internet of Things (IoT) due to its ultra-low energy consumption. By incorporating with orthogonal space-time block code (OSTBC) which is an effective multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) techniques, the transmission performance of backscatter communication can be significantly improved to satisfy the requirements of various IoT applications. Nevertheless, the MIMO backscatter channel has three operational ends, the query end, the tag end, and the receiving end, which is fundamentally different from the conventional channel. Since Nakagami-m fading can effectively model the multi-path propagation in indoor scenarios, in which backscatter communications are mostly employed, in this paper, the symbol error rate (SER) of OSTBC under unified query (UFQ) and block-level unitary query (BUTQ) approaches over Nakagami­ <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$m$</tex> fading is conducted by simulation. In simulations, various antenna settings and Nakagami parameters are employed to obtain an insight for the performance of OSTBC under various query approaches in MIMO backscatter communications.

articleTitle: Investigation on Modal Signal-to-Crosstalk Ratio of FM-EDFAs with Piezoelectric Fiber Stretcher
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: We investigate the mode coupling in the few-mode erbium-doped fiber wound around the piezoelectric fiber stretcher by the experiments and theoretical analysis. By adjusting the driving voltage, the signal-to-crosstalk ratio (SXR) of LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>, LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11e</inf> and LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11o</inf> modes can be further improved by 0.62dB, 1.03dB and 1.32dB, respectively. The theoretical SXR curves are also obtained from the mode-coupled FM-EDFA model, in agreement with the experimental trend.

articleTitle: Research on Virtual Network Model of Aerospace TT&C Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In the near future, the intelligent integrated TT&C network will have a large number of users, wide distribution, strong dynamics and obvious heterogeneity. The space-time behavior of the whole network is complex, so it is difficult to describe it efficiently by using the traditional TT&C network model. To solve this problem, we put forward the “virtual network model of aerospace TT&C network”. This model breaks the closed architecture of the traditional TT&C network and reconsiders the model of aerospace TT&C network based on the open architecture. Then, based on the idea of mathematical space, we design a multi-dimensional analysis method of TT&C resources, which defines the basic dimensions and operation relationship of diverse, discrete and non-uniform TT&C network resources. This method can more comprehensively describe the resources in the virtual TT&C network and complete the mapping from physical resources to virtual resources. The model proposed in this paper can provide model reference for the construction of Intelligent Integrated aerospace TT&C network in the future.

articleTitle: Turbulence-Resistant Free Space Optical Communication via Chaotic Block-Matching and 3D Filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a chaotic block-matching and three-dimensional (C-BM3D) filtering algorithm to remove the noise and enhance the security in the turbulence channel of free space optical (FSO) communication system. We experimentally demonstrate the performance of C-BM3D by comparing it with chaotic Non-Local Means filtering (C-NLM), chaotic Gaussian filtering and chaotic Median filtering based on Log-normal and Gamma-Gamma turbulence models. The structural similarity index measure (SSIM) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of C-BM3D under Log-normal turbulence model are up to 1.0000 and 93.2853, respectively. Additionally, the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution of C-BM3D has ranked the highest in the Gamma-Gamma turbulence model, and its bit error rate (BER) distribution has kept at less than 0.025, which improves at least 13dB BER performance than that of the other three algorithms. The experimental results indicate that the C-BM3D can be a good candidate for the next generation of FSO communication in security and turbulence resistance.

articleTitle: Deformable Soft Material Shape Sensing Based on Fiber Bragg Grating Array
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The utilization of soft materials is increasingly prevalent in fields such as robotics and actuators, so the shape sensing of these materials becomes particularly significant. We have designed a deformable soft material shape sensor based on a fiber Bragg grating array. Experimental results demonstrate that the sensor exhibits high robustness and excellent repeatability. Additionally, in order to achieve more accurate demodulation of spectral data and shape sensing, we propose the utilization of neural network algorithms to integrate spectral data with shape curve parameters, which are obtained through image recognition.

articleTitle: An Autonomous Mission Planning Method for Spaceborne SAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of high-precision and small-width spaceborne SAR real-time imaging mission, the current method of ground imaging mission planning is not applicable. The spaceborne SAR satellite needs to carry out the onboard imaging mission planning according to the target position and target characteristics. Therefore, a mission planning method for spaceborne SAR imaging is proposed in this paper, the mission planning criteria of spaceborne SAR imaging, the sequence criteria of spaceborne SAR imaging region, the mission planning process of spaceborne SAR imaging, the mission constraints of spaceborne SAR imaging, and the mission planning objective function of spaceborne SAR imaging are presented. According to the characteristics of ground target distribution, the reasonable observation sequence of target region is determined, and the imaging tasks are arranged independently, and the imaging time and the imaging angle of each target point are obtained. Finally, the validity of the proposed method is verified by simulation data.

articleTitle: De-centralized Networked Distributed Collaborative Location of Civil Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Image Transmission Signal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: recently monitoring and locating of civil unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have become research hotspots as the rapid development and application of various UAVs brings increasingly severe safety threaten. The image transmission signals or remote controlling signals of mainstream UAVs feature large signal bandwidth, low signal power spectral density. Frequency-hopping spectrum spreading and direct spectrum spreading technologies are widely applied as well, which further increase the difficulty of detecting the transmitted signals of UAVs. This paper focuses on the technology of locating UAVs through passive time difference positioning methods, and combining the signal transmission characteristics of UAVs, optimizes the time delay estimation algorithm in time difference positioning methods, and designs a distributed collaborative location implements of UAVs based on their image transmission signal, the processing architecture of de-centralized networked location is descripted and the experiment results with actual UAVs are presented to verify the effectiveness of the proposed technology.

Author Keywords: unmanned aerial vehicles monitoring and location

articleTitle: UnetRay: A Prediction Method of Indoor Radio Signal Strength Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Efficient and accurate indoor radio signal strength prediction methods are essential for the design and operation of wireless communication systems. Recently, attempts have been made to combine radio propagation prediction with deep learning. Inspired by recent advances in computer vision, we propose a prediction model using a convolutional encoder-decoder structure fused with Swin Transformer module. Specifically, we embed the Swin Transformer into the U-Net structure to enhance the global modeling capability of the U-Net network, which can be trained to predict the strength of signals received in a given indoor environment. More importantly, once trained for a sufficient number of scenarios, the model can directly predict the signal strength in unknown indoor environments. The simulation results verify that the model is more effective than the traditional U-Net, with a reduction in validation error of about 40%.

articleTitle: Implementation of Pump Condition Monitoring Function Based on Handheld Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: As a large-scale device, pump equipment is usually stored in the industrial site, with the characteristics of complex site environment and concentrated equipment location, and requires on-site inspection personnel to regularly inspect to eliminate faults. The traditional central control room uses the PC to monitor the industrial site, and there is a common problem of untimely fault feedback, so it is necessary to use handheld explosion-proof equipment to obtain the equipment status immediately. Narrowband Internet of Things (NB IoT) and Bluetooth (BT) protocols are both wireless communication protocol technologies. Due to the widespread use of Bluetooth technology in mobile devices such as smartphones, it is necessary to design command formats and implement programs based on Bluetooth technology. As a more cutting-edge technology than BT, NB technology can serve as a supplement to system data transmission due to its low power consumption and low-frequency characteristics. Therefore, the work of this article mainly revolves around these two technologies. This article first explores the similarities and differences between NB and BT protocols in pump status monitoring, and then expands on how to develop command formats for specific pump equipment status monitoring tasks. Finally, based on the format of parameter setting commands and data packet transmission commands, the writing process of mobile terminal programs was explained, and the final implementation results were provided.

articleTitle: Application of Remote Sensing Image Processing for Classification and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulties in object detection and recognition in remote sensing images caused by high background complexity, large scale variations of targets, and the presence of numerous small objects, an improved method for remote sensing image object detection based on YOLOv7-tiny is proposed. This method combines the loss function based on normalized Gaussian Wasserstein distance (NWD) with the CIoU loss function to address the problem of sensitivity to positional deviation of small objects by IoU-Loss. The addition of a global attention mechanism (GAM) in the backbone network reduces information diffusion and enhances the interaction at the global dimension to mitigate the interference of complex backgrounds in remote sensing images on the model, enabling the model to focus on the feature extraction of the desired targets. Finally, the coupled detection head (Coupled Head) of the model is replaced with a decoupled detection head (Decoupled Head), allowing the classification and regression tasks to output from different branches to achieve decoupling and avoid the decrease in detection accuracy caused by conflicts between classification and regression. The experimental results of this method on the public dataset DIOR achieved 88.73% accuracy, which is an improvement of 1.78% compared to the unimproved method's accuracy of 86.95%. Furthermore, compared to other researchers' methods tested on DIOR, the proposed method also shows improvement, thus validating its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Real-Time Parallel LU Decomposition of Space Debris Features On-Board
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This paper provides a parallel LU decomposition calculation method for on orbit Real-time computing calculation of space debris target characteristics. The purpose is to overcome the shortcomings of the traditional LU decomposition design, carry out high-precision approximate calculation of division in the LU calculation process, design a full pipeline parallel computing architecture based on digital logic devices according to the interrelationship between Land <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$U$</tex> matrix elements, and design the calculation process and timing of each sub step by combing the correlation of each element in the calculation process, Real time LU decomposition of space target is realized on the basis of ensuring the calculation accuracy and executable frequency, and the target principal component features are obtained. The LU solution based on this design can effectively distinguish the characteristics of stars and debris targets in batches. Through experimental verification, the overall calculation performance has been improved by an order of magnitude compared to previous designs, and the designed fixed point calculation error is not more than 1%.

articleTitle: Macroscopic Air-based Molecular Communication using Fluorescein for Sustainable Industrial IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Sustainable Industrial Internet-of-Things (IIoT) or Green IIoT becomes an important research area in IIoT given the large increase in energy prices in the post-COVID era and the continual introduction of carbon emission regulations to industry sectors by the government. The greening of IIoT focuses on developing energy-efficient IIoT to create a sustainable environment. Despite the fact that the dominant solution to sustainable IIoT has yet to emerge, molecular communication is one of the main players to realize extremely low energy consumption for low-speed communication channels. In this paper, a two-stage molecular communication system that reused a surveillance-camera-based receiver for an IIoT scenario is envisioned, in order to achieve a stable communication channel with low Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI) while maintaining low energy consumption. A hardware-in-loop simulation is performed for feasibility check based on bit-error-rate (BER) analysis. Utilizing the correction coefficients obtained from the experiment of concentration model calibration, simulation is further conducted. Simulation results show that the proposed system is able to achieve BER of 0.04 and below in a distance of 20 m with proper configurations.

articleTitle: Onboard Reconfiguration Method for Routing FPGA Programs in LEO Satellite Constellations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: To enhance the agility of space network reconfiguration and onboard reliability, this paper introduces an onboard reconfiguration method for routing FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Arrays) programs tailored for Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite constellations. This approach establishes a closed-loop autonomous control system encompassing the entire onboard reconfiguration process, including reconfiguration data segmentation, telecommand instructions generation, RAM (Random-Access Memory) data verification, FLASH erasure, FLASH programming, and FLASH data validation. These steps ensure the reliability of the onboard reconfiguration process, with the capability to identify and correct bit errors throughout the entire process. Experimental results demonstrate that this method enables high-reliability onboard maintenance of FPGA programs, aligning with design requirements, and enhancing the onboard maintainability and scalability of space networks.

articleTitle: Analysis of Outage Probability for Intelligent Reflecting Surface Assisted Downlink NOMA Symbiotic Radio System in κ-μ Fading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Symbiotic Radio (SR) and Intelligent Reflective Surface (IRS) have emerged as pivotal enablers in the realm of next-generation wireless communication systems, attracting substantial interest from both scholarly circles and industry domains. The SR system presents a sanguine technical resolution aimed at surmounting the exacting requisites of the sixth-generation mobile communication technology, which lays great emphasis on transmission rates and device densities. In the present study, our focus resides on an in-depth performance analysis of IRS-facilitated, multiplexed Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) within the purview of SR systems, operating within κ-μ shaded fading channels. The envisaged scenario encompasses a transmitter employing downlink NOMA for signal transmission, while all channel links are subjected to κ-μ fading phenomena. Our analytical journey commences with the derivation of a precise expression encapsulating the outage probability pertinent to the collective receiver framework. Additionally, we advance an approximation technique for the outage probability, ingeniously wielded through a univariate degradation algorithm. We subject our derived findings to rigorous verification via Monte Carlo simulations. The outcomes derived from this empirical validation elegantly affirm the fidelity of our approximation algorithm. Noteworthy observations surface, showcasing that the outage probability attains a state of saturation at elevated Signal-to-N oise Ratio (SNR) regimes. Conversely, we discern that augmenting the count of reflection units imparts a marginal influence upon the outage probability when SNR dwells at lower levels.

articleTitle: Separation of Mixed Near-field and Far-field Sources and DOA Estimation based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the common mixed sources including near-field(NF) and far-field(FF), this paper proposes a mixed sources direction-of-arrival(DOA) estimation method based on Deep Learning(DL). By using the real part and imaginary part of the mixed sources as the input of the neural network, after full separation, the expected FF signals and NF signals can be obtained at the output of the network. Then, the traditional estimation methods for a single source can be used to estimate DOA. The proposed method optimizes some defects existing in the estimation of mixed sources containing near and far fields in the past, such as the inability to separate the mixed sources effectively, and a large loss of array aperture. Simulation results show that the proposed method is effective. Under different SNR or channel error conditions, the proposed method has better DOA estimation accuracy and generalization ability than most super-resolution DOA estimation algorithms.

articleTitle: RRDP : An Ruin-Rebuild Based Approach for Dynamic Route Mapping in Multi-Robots Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Single-robot Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) suffers from low accuracy and limited search range, which motivates the research on multi-robot SLAM technologies. However, most existing multi-robot SLAM algorithms do not exploit the prior environmental information sufficiently, resulting in deadlocks or failures during the autonomous exploration and mapping process. Moreover, they often face challenges such as overlapping area matching failure during map fusion, which degrades the map quality and completeness. To tackle these problems in multi-robot map construction, this paper proposes an improved approach based on the Ruin-Rebuild Dynamic Planning (RRDP) algorithm for dynamic routing in multi-robot scenarios. It incorporates a feedback mechanism to achieve stable control and autonomous map construction by following pre-defined auxiliary paths. Experiments show that the RRDP approach outperforms previous methods in terms of map integrity, accuracy, and mapping time.

articleTitle: A Protocol Reversing Framework for TDMA Bitstream
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Bitstream protocol reversing has broad applications in the areas of information security and network confrontation. This paper proposes a framework for reversing bitstream protocols. Firstly, an improved correlation operation is proposed to search for synchronization sequences based on the periodicity of the TDMA signal. Then, channel encode parameters are identified through statistical analysis of code block features. Finally scramble parameters are identified through exploiting the imbalance in source distribution probabilities. To validate the proposed framework, DVB-RCS protocol is chosen for reversing, and the structure of data frames is analyzed and the information is successfully recovered. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework can effectively accomplish reversing of TDMA bitstream protocols.

articleTitle: Prediction Method for Internal Overheating Defects of GIS Isolation Switch Based on Multi-Parameter Correlation and Deep Learning Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Due to its fully enclosed design and complex internal heat transfer processes, GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear) equipment presents challenges in quickly diagnosing and warning about internal defects when anomalies occur. The internal temperature field becomes intricate and difficult to monitor, leading to significant difficulties in promptly diagnosing and alerting about internal defects, which, in turn, severely impacts the safe operation of the equipment. This paper addresses the issue of overheating defects in GIS equipment by designing an online monitoring scheme for such defects using various monitoring methods. Based on multiple monitoring approaches, the paper calculates the weight allocation of each monitoring dataset by analyzing their correlations. A dual-layer LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) network is then employed for prediction. Through experimental data and case studies, the proposed method demonstrates more accurate, convenient, and stable diagnosis of overheating defects within GIS isolation switchgear equipment. Compared to traditional heat monitoring techniques, it offers higher detection accuracy and timely alerts. This approach is adaptable to various scenarios involving overheating defects, and it effectively enhances the capability of detecting overheating defects in power equipment, ensuring the secure operation of GIS isolation switchgear equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Terahertz Communication System and the Prospect on Space Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Terahertz has been rated as one of the “top ten technologies to change the future world”. It has preeminent transmission characteristics such as large transmission capacity, small terminal size, good transmission security and abundant frequency resources, which is widely used in the fields of detection, detection, medicine and safety monitoring. In recent years, with the rapid development of terahertz sources and power devices, the research of terahertz communication systems has also received wide attention. While terahertz ground communication system is moving towards practical applications, the space application is still in the demonstration stage. Therefore, it is necessary to investigate terahertz communication systems for space applications. Communication properties and characteristics of terahertz waves are introduced in this article, and differences with microwave and laser are analyzed. The space frequency planning is provided, and the technical research progress is reviewed. It provides the prospect for the development of terahertz space communication systems, hoping to promote the research and popularization of terahertz technology in space application fields.

articleTitle: On-board Time-varying Topology Self Prediction Routing Network Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Facing the difficulties of large-scale networked satellite communication, such as unstable topology, diversified channel types, and uncertain satellite link failure, this paper proposes a general optimal routing path calculation method based on historical data prediction, and establishes a Statistical model based on historical data prediction for inter satellite communication transmission, which is not limited to transient failures caused by aging energy, storage, and load. At the same time, in the process of calculating the transmission rate and packet loss rate of the communication link, historical data is introduced to form a channel rate function that changes over time, which is used to achieve communication prediction within the transmission time and achieve self-sensing of the communication link's state. Based on the self-prediction state of the communication link, combined with the domain search algorithm, the maximum probability optimal solution of the long-term interactive routing process is considered to achieve real-time optimal solution for data transmission in the constellation of Jupiter in orbit. A simulation verification was conducted for a large number of randomly distributed routing applications in a short period of time, and parameters such as link stability, load capacity, and business time delay were compared with previous designs. The results show that the proposed method has good stability, which is more than 10% higher than previous designs; The link load is significantly lower compared to previous designs; Under the condition of a large number of routing applications, the service delay has been reduced by 27% compared to previous designs, ensuring routing communication under the time-varying topology of the constellation group.

articleTitle: Design of Self-energy Recycling for Full Duplex MISO-SWIPT Secure Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This paper studies the energy harvesting(EH) and physical layer security problems of a full duplex simultaneous wireless information and power transfer communication network with multiple eavesdropping nodes were studied, and proposes a secure beamforming design scheme aided by artificial noise. This scheme considers communication security constraints, user uplink rate constraints, and minimum EH threshold constraints, and establishes a transmission power minimization model based on self-energy recycling mechanism. By optimizing the artificial noise covariance, uplink and downlink beamforming vectors, and power allocation factors, it utilizes energy access points to further supplement user's energy, optimizing the total transmission power of the system. As the original optimization problem is non convex, we use the two-stage optimization approach to transform the problem into two sub-problems, and utilize the semi definite relaxation technique and particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve they respectively. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme can effectively reduce the transmission power of the system while ensuring basic downlink secure transmission and meet user EH and uplink transmission requirements.

Author Keywords: simultaneous wireless information and power transfer

articleTitle: An Image Denoising Method Based on Visual Perception
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: To address the problem of image quality degradation caused by noise during image acquisition and transmission, this article proposes an improved image denoising model based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN). The generator network of this model uses a combination of convolutional blocks, residual blocks, and deconvolutional blocks to efficiently extract low-level and high-level feature information to avoid loss of image details and effectively alleviate the problem of gradient disappearance in the network. To improve discrimination accuracy, the discriminator network is adjusted on the basis of the VGG network to achieve pixel-level classification. The loss function consists of a composite loss function composed of Mean Square Error (MSE) loss, visual perception loss, and adversarial loss, considering both the image denoising ability and the preservation of image detail information. Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms mainstream image denoising techniques in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and visualization effects, indicating that the model can effectively remove image noise while making the image more in line with human visual perception.

articleTitle: Deceptive Interference Detection for GNSS-Based Train Positioning using a PSO-XGBoost Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: The Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) has received considerable attention in railway train positioning and state awareness because of its high accuracy and service coverage. However, the vulnerability of GNSS constrained the availability and achievable positioning performance under interference attack scenarios, especially the GNSS deceptive interference. The attack may lead to great threats to the safety of the positioning results if they are not effectively detected and isolated. In order to mitigate the negative effects from interference attacks, this paper proposes a novel data-driven deceptive interference detection method for GNSS-based train positioning. In this method, the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) strategy is involved to enhance the efficiency of hyperparameter adjustment for the eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) model training.
