This method is assessed through the interference injection tests concerning different GNSS deception signal types. The results show that the proposed method is capable of accurately detecting the injected interference over other related detection solutions, which shows great potentials in enabling the active GNSS protection at the information security stage for the GNSS-based train positioning system.

articleTitle: Verifiable Multi-Key Privacy Data Computing System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Secure storage and computing of ciphertext data is an important research area in cloud computing. Homomorphic encryption (HE) is a popular ciphertext computing technique, but most homomorphic computing requires encryption using the same public key. This restricts the application scenarios and compromises the security of the system. To address this issue, we propose a verifiable multi-key secure computing system for off-line non-real-time data, which solves the multi-key issue with a double-trapdoor HE scheme. Additionally, we propose a lightweight commitment algorithm(LC) that generates commitments using the existing operators of the encryption algorithm, reducing computation. Our proposed system employs two types of servers for ciphertext outsourcing calculation, with the blockchain acting as a supervisor to prevent the servers' collusion. Furthermore, the LC algorithm is used to verify the accuracy of data addition and multiplication results. Security analysis shows that the blockchain can improve system security by detecting information exchanged by servers. We also present simulation results that demonstrate the feasibility and accuracy of the system, as well as the low time consumption of the LC algorithm.

articleTitle: Infrared image interest point detector for few samples Based on Superpoint
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor robustness and many misselected points when extracting interest points from a small number of infrared images, an interest point detection algorithm based on improved Superpoint for infrared images with few samples is proposed. First, self-supervised methods are used in the data annotation phase to reduce the cost of manual annotation and the problem of defining points of interest caused by individual subjectivity. The improved Superpoint algorithm is then used to train the optical remote sensing images to enhance the performance of the detector. Finally training on a small number of infrared images by transfer learning. The improved algorithm is evaluated against different algorithms on a small number of infrared image datasets and a generic Haptches datasets, The results show that the improved algorithm maintains some generality and achieves excellent performance, has better robustness in processing images with low resolution and high noise, and can provide more reliable points of interest for subsequent image matching tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Lunar Communication Network Architecture and Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In recent years, human enthusiasm for exploring the moon has gradually increased, and China has also made continuous achievements in the field of lunar exploration. The lunar communication network, as an important infrastructure to support activities on the lunar surface, has become a research hotspot for various space powers. Aiming at the problems of how to design the system architecture of lunar surface communication network (LSCN), the development trend of cislunar space communication system among major space powers is investigated and analyzed. The feasibility of the application of terrestrial mobile communication technology on the lunar surface is analyzed, the protocol scheme of the LSCN based on the convergence of simplified 5G and Wi-Fi is obtained, and the basic communication protocol framework, routing method, and protocol characteristics are proposed. Finally, the development research suggestions are given around how to build LSCN, and the future development direction is prospected.

articleTitle: Review on Sentiment Analysis of E-commerce Product Comments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Deeply mining and analyzing the comment data of e-commerce products is of great significance to reduce consumers' perceived risk and assist consumers in decision-making. Through literature research, this paper combs and summarizes the technical development trend and application scenarios of emotional analysis of e-commerce product comments. Firstly, the acquisition method, preprocessing method and text representation method of Chinese comment text data are described; Secondly, it introduces text emotion analysis based on different models and technologies; Then it analyzes the influence mechanism of comment text on e-commerce product sales, the information attribute and emotional attribute of comment, and the latest research results of the impact of comment contradiction on e-commerce product network sales; Finally, it is proposed that future research will further focus on improving the quality of comment data, integrating multimodal data in comments and studying the role of emoticons in emotional expression.

articleTitle: Security Task Unloading of Wireless Powered Mobile Edge Computing System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: This paper considers a wireless powered mobile edge computing(MEC) system with multiple user nodes and some eavesdropping nodes, studies the physical layer security offloading and resource allocation of wireless powered MEC systems, and proposes a resource allocation scheme for the wireless powered MEC security offloading system suitable for offline state. Under the constraints of ensuring energy harvesting, secure offloading, and computational delay, this scheme achieves the minimization of system's access point(AP) energy consumption by jointly optimizing the covariance matrix of AP energy transmission, local CPU frequency, number of user offloading bits, allocation of user offloading time, and user transmission power. In the process of solving the problem, a difference of convex algorithm(DCA) is first used to convert the original non convex problem into a convex problem, and then the Lagrange duality method is used to solve the optimal solution of the problem in a semi closed form. The simulation experimental results show that the proposed secure partial offloading scheme can effectively reduce AP energy consumption and have good performance gains.

articleTitle: Routing and Spectrum Resource Allocation for Advance Reservation Services in the Space-Terrestrial Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, Space-Terrestrial Integrated Network have become a popular topic of research and have been included in the National 13th Five-Year Plan and the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Science and Technology Innovation. In recent years, with the booming development of Internet technology, the Internet has entered every household and gradually integrated into people's daily life and become an indispensable part of it. At present, the ground network can cover most areas, but places like Tibet, Inner Mongolia and other remote areas such as mountains, oceans and deserts cannot be covered, and satellite networks can solve such problems very effectively, not only do not need to build a large number of ground base stations, but also enable the network to achieve global coverage. Network technology has brought more types of services to satellite networks, such as data upload, data backup, grid computing, cloud computing, etc. A Space-Terrestrial Integrated Network refers to the integration of communication networks on the ground, in the air and in space into a unified network system to achieve efficient, reliable and secure information transmission on a global scale. Reservation service is an important type of service in the integrated network between heaven and earth, which requires a certain amount of resources to be reserved in the network to meet the communication needs of users at a specific time and place. This paper proposes a routing and spectrum resource allocation algorithm based on the reservation service of the Space-Terrestrial Integrated Network, which dynamically adjusts and optimizes the resource allocation strategy in the network according to the characteristics and demands of the reservation service, so as to achieve a reasonable allocation and utilization of resources. Based on the traditional Dijkstra routing algorithm, the K-strip shortest path algorithm (KSP) with load balancing Yen is proposed. With a data volume of 200, experiments show that the algorithm is able to reduce the blocking rate to 2% in the reservation service of the Space-Terrestrial Integrated Network.

articleTitle: A Physical Cell Identity Combinatorial Optimal Configuration Scheme Based on PCIs Grouping and Cells Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: Physical Cell Identity (PCI), as a significant network configuration parameter, is a key factor in the process of User Equipment (UE) accessing to the cell. There are more cells than the number of PCIs, as cell density grows in the ultra dense network, unreasonable PCI configuration will cause conflicts, confusions and Mod-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> conflicts (CCM) between cells. However, there is still a lack of work related to the effect of the Mod-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> conflict during PCI configuration. In this paper, we propose a PCI configuration scheme that can reduce the occurrence of CCM among cells by using PCIs Grouping and Cells Clustering (named as PGCC). First, a CCM graph is established based on location and handover rate among cells. Second, PCIs are divided into different groups according to Mod-<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k$</tex> conflicts, and cells are clustered by the number of groups. Then, the graph coloring algorithm is used to configure the PCI based on the grouping and clustering. Finally, the effectiveness of the scheme is verified by numerous simulation experiments. Compared to other schemes, the PGCC scheme can reduce CCM between cells.

articleTitle: Adaptive Networking and Routing Technology for Time-Varying Topology Group Nodes in Lunar Exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: A routing method based on hierarchical adaptive switching of heterogeneous subnetworks is proposed, which is used to address the local speed reduction and interruption effects caused by complex terrain ground environment interference on group mobile nodes. Firstly, by designing a universal networking and routing model, taking into account the impact of changes in energy, storage, and communication links on the network. Then, a two-level network architecture is formed based on sub network clustering and partitioning. At last, local and global predictions are introduced to design the optimal model for dealing with time-varying topology, improving the accuracy and reliability of routing during lunar data transmission. Compared to conventional single constraint models, independent resource calculation and path planning are performed on each subnet to ensure that even in the event of individual carrier interruption loss during the task process, the optimal replacement topology of the network can be quickly formed. After simulation experiment analysis, statistical results of routing request ratio, number of faults, data packets, and routing rate delay were obtained. The routing delay is at the millisecond level, indicating that the algorithm model has good fidelity and real-time performance in applications above 10 nodes on the lunar surface.

articleTitle: An algorithm of non-uniform cluster head selection and energy supplement based on virtual force
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), the energy structure and the network life are two important performance metrics. Although many existing routing protocols have achieved the goal of optimizing the network structure and prolonging the life cycle, facing the uneven distribution of nodes and the power difference in the uneven network, how to dynamically optimize the selection of cluster heads has become the key to improve the network performance. This paper proposes a non-uniform Virtual Force-based Cluster Head and Energy Supply (VF-CHES) algorithm. The virtual force algorithm is introduced in cluster head selection, and then the residual energy, the node power, the distribution density and other influencing factors are comprehensively considered to make cluster head selection more suitable for heterogeneous networks. According to the network structure, wireless charging vehicle (WCV) is introduced to take charge of energy supply, and the collection of nodes to be charged and the sleep mechanism are designed, and the virtual force model of the vehicle in the steady-state network is analyzed, and the route of the vehicle is reasonably planned to extend the life of the node. Simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively optimize the energy structure, avoid the energy holes and prolong the network life in heterogeneous networks.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Joint BEM-OTFS Channel Estimation Algorithm Based Sparse Bayesian Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 15th International Conference on Advanced Infocomm Technology (ICAIT)
abstract: In this paper, a two-stage BEM-OTFS channel sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) estimation algorithm is proposed to address the problem of increasing error of the compressed sensing channel estimation algorithm at low resolution when OTFS is embedded in the pilot frequency mode and the pilot frequency overhead is too large. The algorithm uses a complex exponential basis expansion model (CE-BEM) at the transmitter side to design a design mode with lower pilot overhead, and a linear solution is used to obtain the roughly estimating channel matrix. After detecting the rough estimated channels, some of data symbols detected are used as pseudo-pilot for the second stage estimation. In the second stage, a sparse expression about the basis parameters is constructed using the discrete prolate spheroidal basis expansion model (DPS-BEM), which is solved by the SBL algorithm to calculate a more accurate channel after the sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) algorithm. The simulated numerical analysis shows that the present algorithm has ideal performance for OTFS symbols with lower Resolution, which is better than the SBL algorithm which is based on the DD domain pilot input-output relationship in general. Meanwhile, the present algorithm also has some advantages in spectral efficiency.
